commits.message:
fix: improve Vitest setup, add CI workflow and Makefile integration

- Fix coverage: manually instrument admin.js with istanbul-lib-instrument
  before eval in JSDOM, then copy __coverage__ data back to Vitest's
  Istanbul reporter (v8/istanbul providers cannot instrument code loaded
  via eval — this bridges the JSDOM sandbox to Node.js globalThis)
- Add @vitest/coverage-istanbul and istanbul-lib-instrument dependencies
- Add coverage config to vitest.config.js (istanbul provider, lcov+html)
- Refactor test setup: move JSDOM init to beforeAll/afterAll to
  prevent state leakage across test files
- Add Makefile targets: test-js, test-js-coverage, test-js-watch, test-js-ui
- Include test-js in test-all and test-full targets
- Add .github/workflows/vitest.yml CI workflow
- Update docs with coverage and make target references

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
feat: maximize JS test coverage for admin.js with 258 new tests

Add 6 new categorized test files covering all pure/near-pure utility
functions in admin.js, bringing total from 13 to 271 tests. Extract
shared JSDOM + Istanbul instrumentation into a reusable helper with
coverage counter merging across test files.

New test files:
- admin-validation.test.js (92 tests): security-critical validators
- admin-formatting.test.js (46 tests): formatting/display utilities
- admin-parsing.test.js (47 tests): parsing and data extraction
- admin-display.test.js (39 tests): CSS class mapping and HTML gen
- admin-config.test.js (27 tests): config/state lookup functions
- admin-errors.test.js (7 tests): error handling utilities

Coverage improvement (admin.js):
- Statements: 4.48% → 6.29% (+40%)
- Branches:   1.71% → 4.51% (+164%)
- Functions:   5.39% → 8.93% (+66%)

Closes #2788

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
